note: S1782: the acceptance bound for the concealment axis, derived from a dated report and not from a value chosen while writing this file (S1716 ADR-3). Moving it must show up as a difference between two reports.
axisMeaning: share of the source text's own contrast still visible after the overlay drew; 0 is a plate nothing reads through, 1 is no plate at all
boundIsAt: the worst measured value, not above it

derivedFrom.reportPathAtRunTime: temp/ocrbench/<date>/overlay-concealment-report.md - where each run writes, and disposable by CLAUDE.md Rule 1; the kept copy above is the durable one
derivedFrom.printPrecision: 4 decimal places - the report's own, so the bound carries its rounding and no other slack

knownCause: S2064 - the plate ships at 94 % alpha because sampleBackgroundColor overwrites the opaque default, so this bound records a defect rather than a target. Re-derive it from a fresh report once S2064 lands.
axesNotBounded: found, overlap and spill belong to S1716 and are not bounded here
